Product Engineer — AI Operator

Ever Tech · Sofia or remote in EU time zones

An engineering role responsible for client outcomes and the quality of work delivered by a small team of AI agents.

Responsibilities

  • Operate AI agents and review the quality of their work across client projects.
  • Communicate with clients and handle architecture and more complex product work.

Requirements

  • At least 3 years building and shipping web products.
  • Experience with TypeScript, PostgreSQL, Git and testing.
  • Practical experience with AI coding agents and clear written English.

Conditions

  • Remote in EU time zones or based in Sofia.
  • 25 days of leave, equipment, model budget and conference budget.
